verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly touches this story. A help-center keyword index lists 'channels', 'channel management' and 'Add members'. A community post about export restrictions mentions 'private channels', which shows that the private/public distinction exists. Docs also reference searching channels and messaging 'any type of conversation'. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of creating public vs. private channels, admin membership controls (invite/remove, posting permissions, who can create channels), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
